e1_rule: Base = LIA S0 (support {on, <=3px, >3px} x catalogue {0-4, 4-20, >20 px}, 9 bins). Each field replaces the 3 off-support bins by off-support x catalogue x field level {top 3%, 3-15%, rest} (quantiles over valid off-support cells; 9 bins). NNLS ridge 1e-3, c = 2. Metric: LOO MSE over the 95 distinct organizer-scored rasters; paired bootstrap (4000) of the LOO MSE reduction vs S0. A field is LIVE-SUPPORTED if the 95% CI excludes 0 and at least one off-support top-level bin has h > 0. The field with the largest mean reduction is selected (selection over ~10 rows is disclosed; E2 is the independent check).
e2_rule: Template gems57 evaluator (vendor/template66, unchanged), buffered_component_draw seed=20 hide_frac=0.20 buffer_px=3. Candidate arm rebuilt per fold from the VISIBLE catalogue: on-support dots greedy by S0 credit (>B px from visible catalogue), off-support dots greedy by the selected field (>3 px from support, >4 px from visible catalogue), on-share <= 0.66 and per-raster overlap budget 0.66. Arms: candidate, champion construction (H19-5 dots >2 px from visible catalogue), selected field alone, random. Leakage canary: every feature alone, AUC > 0.90 = leakage.
promotion_rule: unique: rho <= 0.90 and dot overlap <= 0.70 vs every informative registry raster, on the surface and on the final dots; space-filling rasters reported
selected-model LOO-validated projection delta vs the champion >= 0
paired HOLDOUT-DTI delta vs champion construction has a 95% CI not entirely below 0
verdict_if_any_fails: negative (deliverable). The selector, not this lane, decides any slot.
budget: 3 experiments (E1 screen, E2 holdout + canary, E3 build + uniqueness + validator), 2 hours wall-clock target
